correct_completion: she would have passed the exam.
full_sentence: Had she studied more carefully, she would have passed the exam.
acceptable_variants: she would have gotten a better grade.

options.text: she would have passed the exam.
she passes the exam every year.
options.why_wrong: The present simple describes a habit and does not match the hypothetical past condition set by 'Had she studied'.

options.text: so she passed the exam easily.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result that actually happened, but the conditional inversion requires a hypothetical result such as 'would have passed'.

options.text: she has been studying for years.
options.why_wrong: The present perfect continuous does not complete a third conditional sentence; the main clause needs 'would have' plus a past participle.

grammar_focus: Third conditional with inversion (Had + subject + past participle)
explanation: Inverted 'Had + subject + past participle' replaces 'If + past perfect', so the main clause must use 'would have + past participle' to express an unreal past result.
